messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — PR #4281 (auth middleware rebase) is ready but needs security sign-off before merge. It touches the on-prem auth flow and adds a SECRET_BACKEND env var. Default fallback is 'legacy' which reads plaintext. ping @ryan @samir :eyes:

ryan: Can you drop the PR link and the minimal diff? I'll take a look now.

marta: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4281

marta: Diff snippet:
```
backend = os.getenv('SECRET_BACKEND', 'legacy')
if backend == 'legacy':
    return read_legacy_secret(key)
else:
    return kms_client.decrypt(key)
```

samir: Yikes — fallback to legacy plaintext on missing env is risky for on-prem. We can't merge with a plaintext code path enabled by default. :lock:

alex: Is this blocking today's deploy? What's the urgency on merging?

marta: Not blocking the deploy. Wanted to merge before other big rebases to avoid conflicts. Can push a quick fix if needed.

samir: We need a small checklist before I can approve:
- require explicit SECRET_BACKEND value (no default)
- add unit test for both branches
- migration doc + instructions for on-prem customers
- optional feature flag gated behind rollout policy
Also run an SCA scan.

sec-bot: Automated scan result: SNYK HIGH — plaintext secret access pattern detected in function read_legacy_secret (file: auth/secret_loader.py:42)

marta: OK, will remove the default, add tests and migrate note. I'll push update in ~30m and re-request reviews. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ryan: I'll re-review after your push. If you need a fast LGTM from me once tests pass, ping me.

samir: I'll do final security sign-off after checklist items are addressed. Prefer to avoid emergency patches later.

marta: Understood. Pushing change shortly. Closing the loop here.
